Here’s how your escrow account can get a negative balance.

When we get a bill for your property taxes, insurance premium or any other bill that is paid from your escrow account, there is a chance the amount due is more than what is available in your escrow account. To make sure your bill is paid in full, we advance the money to your escrow account. You can see which payment from your escrow account caused this to happen by looking at your Mortgage Statement or by viewing the history online.
